card_optimizer_agent.name: Card Optimizer Agent
card_optimizer_agent.description: Analyzes user's expense categories against their card portfolio's reward structures globally. Recommends the optimal card for each spending category. Detects spending milestones, transfer limits, and optimization opportunities. Parses card bills/statements.

card_alternatives_agent.name: Card Alternatives Agent
card_alternatives_agent.description: Evaluates user's spending patterns and current card portfolio globally, then searches for alternative credit cards offering better overall value. Performs real-time card information lookups for any card worldwide.

rewards_strategist_agent.name: Rewards Strategist Agent
rewards_strategist_agent.description: Tracks point balances across all user cards globally and provides optimal redemption strategies — including transfer partner valuations, multi-hop transfer chains, point purchase opportunities, and transfer limit warnings.
